summary: Deprecated all-in-one shared object node. Use Model2 (Object) plus NewModel and SetModelProperties.
description: The legacy Model node combined reading, creating and storing a shared client-side object in one node. Its successors split the roles: Object (Model2) reads reactively by id, New Object creates, Set Object Properties writes. The object store is shared, so legacy graphs and new nodes see the same objects by id.
whenToUse: Do not use in new graphs — use Model2 with NewModel/SetModelProperties instead.
runtimeBehavior: Property ports are generated from the per-instance `properties` list (runtime-discovered), as on its successors.
